maria: Quick brief 7 pulling a compact benchmark narrative + webinar for launch week. Need: one short post, three charts, 30-min demo webinar, and inbound routing rules.

devon: For hooks let's run: 1) dollars per 1k tokens (real workloads), 2) tail latency exposure (p99 gaps), 3) cost per response across batch sizes.

sam: Hero chart idea: single-panel scatter showing $/1k (x) vs median latency ms (y) with a clear Redwood optimized series and a baseline series. Callouts for chat-512 and long-context.

maria: Keep headline conservative: "See how batching + cache change the math" and subhead with conditional claim: "Up to 5x cost improvement in our testbed; typical customers 2x-3x." Link methodology.

leo: Routing rules (sketch): if clicked_pdf OR clicked_dedicated -> AE+SE; if webinar_attendee AND company_size>200 -> AE outreach; otherwise -> nurture drip and quickstart. Add "primary use case" on form for qualification.

sam: Chart deep dives: tail latency (p50/p95/p99 area), throughput econ (cost per 1k responses by batch size), and hero latency vs cost. Include hardware and prompt-length assumptions in captions.

maria: Webinar format: 10m highlights, 12m live demo (batching + prefix cache + quantize), 8m Q&A + CTA (free eval run). Devon, can you draft the 2-paragraph blog lead and one-pager outline?

devon: Yep  will push a draft and simple SVG mocks by EOD.

marketing-bot: Webinar scheduled: https://cal.link/redwood-bench-signal  slots Tue 11am / Thu 3pm.

maria: Nice. Quick checklist: blog lead + SVGs (devon), chart captions + methodology link (sam), routing JSON (leo), microcopy variants for hero and CTA (maria). Target drafts in 48 hours.

sam: I'll keep chart mocks reproducible and add links to eval scripts.

maria: Thanks all  conservative claims, transparent methods, short tactical webinar. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:
